title: melissa serpyllifolia
intro: Melissa serpyllifolia, commonly known as Thyme-leaved Speedwell, is a low-growing, perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat anxiety, insomnia, and stress-related disorders. Thyme-leaved Speedwell is said to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting respiratory health. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep quality.
